# EngSpace · Engineering Workspace

> Project intelligence for engineering and construction offices. It reads the
> project's own contract, specifications, drawings and correspondence, checks
> outgoing RFIs, letters, submittals and claims against them before they are
> issued, and keeps registers, sign-off workflows, claims evidence, drawing
> studios, 43 verified calculators and a company-controlled client portal
> around one project record — on infrastructure the company owns.

Key facts
- Product: Engineering Workspace (brand: EngSpace) — https://engspace.app
- Live application: https://app.engspace.app (sign-in required)
- Company: Engineering Root Solutions (ERS), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Commercial Registration 7054208009
- Founder: Mohamed Abokhatwa (https://abokhatwa.com)
- Contact: support@engspace.app
- Data location: the operating company's own server; local indexing, OCR and
  search (English + Arabic, scanned documents included); answers cite the
  exact document and page
- Signature feature: the outbound check — a draft RFI/letter/submittal/claim
  is checked against the project's own specifications, code editions and
  previous Engineer rulings before it leaves
- Client portal: read-only progress page; the company controls every element
  server-side (sections, plan comparison, disciplines, transmittals, words)
- Pricing: one annual price per workspace, unlimited engineers; free 15-day
  trial; users may bring their own AI key (no per-question fee)
- Proven on a live mega-project: 72,000+ documents indexed, 5,300+ sign-offs,
  14 engineers in parallel (first-party measurements; method on /proven.html)
